title: Apollinarius and Nestorius share one impiety
english: I consider the opinion of Apollinarius and the blasphemy of Nestorius to be one and the same impiety. I believe it is the same error to ascribe division or a duality to the Only-Begotten Son of God according to the incarnation, and not to confess that his flesh, which has a soul and is all-holy, is human except for sin alone. It is the same error to say either that his flesh had its existence from heaven, or that it came into being through a change of the Word. To those who have fallen into any such error, I say, quoting Scripture, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures.”
